messages:
marta (Docs): Opening a small PR to consolidate guidance for 429s/timeouts when teams switch to streaming: includes a 'surgical clipper' prompt trimmer, exponential+jitter retry patterns, and a migration checklist. Need quick review.

samir (Eng): Which failure modes are we highlighting? 429s from rate limits vs. cold KV-cache vs. client retries matter a lot.

marta (Docs): Callout section: (A) client-side token budget exhaustion causing retry storms, (B) KV cache warmup on the serving runtime producing transient 429 spikes, (C) trimming bugs that drop function markers.

elaine (DevEx): For snippets, include: 1) short Python retry with exp+jitter + respect Retry-After, 2) JS streaming abort -> fallback sync call with trimmed prompt. I'll port JS.

samir (Eng): Add micro-guidance on ordered fallbacks: same-arch quantized -> lower-context variant -> queued retry. And recommend max attempts and backoff cap to avoid thundering herd.

marta (Docs): Done. Also added a diag note: console trace pattern for cold-cache (many small prefixes -> simultaneous cold reads -> 429s). Suggest synthetic warmup or client-side prefix cache.

alex (PM): Dedicated customers saw autoscale-caused 429 spikes; add a blurb advising fallback routing instead of infinite retries for production.

marta (Docs): Added. Also included a compact migration checklist: measure prefix distribution, set local token budget, enable prefix cache, run synthetic ramp, validate fallback route.

samir (Eng): One nit: emphasize honoring Retry-After header before do-anything sleeps. Also show max_attempts=6 default.

elaine (DevEx): I'll push a JS streaming example tomorrow and co-author the PR. Want to include a tiny E2E demo repo link.

docsbot: PR 5189 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5189 (files: docs/errors/streaming-fallbacks.md, examples/surgical-clipper.py, snippets/js-stream-fallback.md)

marta (Docs): Thanks — will address inline and merge after the JS snippet lands. Target maintenance window Tue 06:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

alex (PM): :rocket:

samir (Eng): LGTM with the Retry-After tweak.
